g.text: 01 SOURCES - systems that emit security events
02 STREAMING ETL - extract, transform, buffer, load
03 COLUMNAR OLAP DATABASE - event store, SQL, RBAC
06 PACKAGING - one immutable container image per concept, configuration baked in, published by CI with an SBOM
07 RUNTIMES - the same three images on interchangeable orchestrators

text.tspan: Role: edge collector on each server or workstation;
reads OS logs, buffers on disk, forwards them
Role: per-node daemon forwards every container's
logs over an authenticated HTTP event API
Role: control-plane, threat, network-flow and access
logs in object storage; a queue announces each object
Role: receive agent and HTTP events, route by source,
normalise to typed rows, disk-buffer, batch-load
Role: consume the notification queue, fetch objects,
normalise to typed rows, disk-buffer, batch-load
Role: one typed columnar table per source; bloom-filter
Role: tiered storage moves older data parts
Role: a materialized view copies every finished
query from the database's own query log
Role: database RBAC - the pipeline may only write;
analyst and auditor identities may only read
Role: dashboards, free-text search, ad-hoc SQL and
per-source silence alerts; the only UI
Role: applies tables, identities and retention,
verifies them, then lets the other services start
Role: sign in to the UI with a local account;
no single sign-on or MFA today
Role: one image, two roles (push or pull),
Role: OLAP server plus the schema job;
tables, config and cold-tier switch baked in
dashboards and alert rules baked in
Role: containers run as system services on one
host, or split with the database on its own host
Role: builds the images locally and runs
the whole stack on one workstation
Role: stateful database plus schema hook job;
CI installs it under restricted Pod Security
Role: not built yet; named as a wave-2
Role: hardened OS image with the stack baked in;
Boxes name concepts, not products (box notes name today's implementation); no arrowheads; OPTIONAL = set by config
